description:
Change the fill color of the Natural Earth countries layer to bright red in gvSIG Desktop.

gvSIG is already open with a View that contains the Natural Earth countries layer (ne_110m_admin_0_countries). Your task:

1. In the View's Table of Contents (the left panel listing layers), find the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer.
2. Double-click the colored square/icon next to the layer name OR right-click the layer and select 'Properties' (Propiedades) to open the Layer Properties dialog.
3. In the Layer Properties dialog, navigate to the 'Symbology' tab.
4. Change the fill color to bright red: click on the fill color swatch and set it to RGB (255, 0, 0) or choose 'Red' from the color picker. Click OK or Accept.
5. The countries layer on the map should now be displayed in red.

The task is complete when the countries polygons are visually filled with red color.
